verdict.rationale: Swell documents its own CSV import and export for products, including categories, which is a bulk operation across many catalog items. It is a single thin marketing mention, limited to products and file transfer. Nothing shows bulk update, delete or batch API operations that an AI-native user could drive programmatically. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete in the dashboard or API, batch API endpoints, coverage beyond products (orders, customers), detailed docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Seamlessly import or export products from CSV files, including product categories.
